name: Casar de Cáceres (Spain)
description: Red field with a white horizontal stripe in the lower part, charged in the upper hoist with the crowned municipal arms of Casar de Cáceres (a castle, a lion and a mount above waves).
history: The arms and the flag of Casar de Cáceres were approved by the Order of 16 February 1994 published in the Diario Oficial de Extremadura on 26 February 1994, after the municipal council's approval on 19 January 1994; the flag is rectangular of 2:3, a red cloth charged with a white stripe of 1/6 of the fly whose upper edge is 1/4 from the lower edge of the flag.

features.role: Casar de Cáceres arms — castle, lion and mount above waves
